candidate.name: lagged displacement mean reversion
candidate.feature: disp_w_lag1 = (close[i-1] - close[i-1-w]) / atr[i-1], w in {4,8} M15 bars
candidate.label: (close[i+h] - close[i]) / atr[i], h in {4,8,16} M15 bars
candidate.direction: NEGATIVE spread: high recent displacement -> lower subsequent return

1_no_shared_price_point.method: feature ends at close[i-1] (lag1) or close[i-2] (lag2); label starts at close[i]
1_no_shared_price_point.verdict: A LARGE PART of the raw effect was endpoint coupling -- retention is only 0.27-0.42 at 1h. A substantial component SURVIVES at 2h and especially 4h with no shared price point and a two-bar gap.

2_atr_denominator.method: label in RAW DOLLARS, removing the 1/atr[i] shared with the feature
2_atr_denominator.verdict: NOT an ATR-denominator artifact; at 4h the dollar result is indistinguishable.

3_displacement_conditioned.method: not applicable to this candidate -- the feature IS displacement, so conditioning on displacement is degenerate
3_displacement_conditioned.note: This control is what ELIMINATED the other 48 survivors: pos_20, pos_50, ma20_dist_atr, dist_high20_atr, dist_low20_atr and close_loc all collapse to |t| < 2.5 within disp_8 strips. They are the same phenomenon measured differently, not independent structures.

4_volatility_conditioned.verdict: SURVIVES in both volatility halves; not a volatility artifact.

5_temporal_stability_TRAIN.verdict: 4h is STABLE -- same sign and near-identical magnitude in all six segments. 1h is weaker and unstable (Q2 -1.1, Q3 -1.6).

6_train_to_dev_replication.verdict: REPLICATES: same sign at every cell, magnitude attenuated ~25-35%.

7_block_shift_null.method: feature circularly shifted 50x with a fixed seed, breaking the feature/label link while preserving each series' own autocorrelation
7_block_shift_null.caveat: This null breaks TIME ALIGNMENT. It cannot detect arithmetic coupling, which exists at every time point. Controls 1 and 2 are what addressed coupling.

8_h1_regime_dependence.verdict: Present in BOTH H1 bull and H1 bear, ABSENT in H1 neutral. The effect is not direction-dependent, which matters because all three dataset arms are net-positive -- it is not a long-bias artifact. H1_NEUT is 13.5% of rows so power is lower there, but t = -0.0 / +0.5 is a clean zero, not a weak signal.

rejected_as_artifact.reason_D_explained_by_another_family: pos_*, ma*_dist, dist_* all collapse within disp_8 strips -- they re-encode recent displacement rather than adding information.
rejected_as_artifact.reason_C_coupling: disp_1 and close_loc additionally FLIP SIGN under the mid[i] reference (disp_1@1h: -13.07 -> +18.91; close_loc@2h: -10.85 -> +11.23). A feature whose sign depends on where the label's origin is placed is measuring the origin.
